labeled_reviews.text: The food is good, but it takes a very long time to come out. The waitstaff is very young, but usually pleasant.
Wow! Yummy, different, delicious. Our favorite is the lamb curry and korma. With 10 different kinds of naan!!!
Terrible experience. The food was cold, the staff was rude, and the prices were outrageous for the quality.
Great place for breakfast! I had the waffle, which was fluffy and perfect. Friendly waitstaff.
Good food--loved the gnocchi with marinara. The service was very slow, but despite this, I'd go back.
